description.en: A session that has no saved switch takes this. A manual stop always wins.
description.zh-CN: 没有历史开关的会话按这个取值；手动关掉的会话不受影响。

description.en: Provider that holds the supervisor model, such as cpa.
description.zh-CN: 监督模型所在的 provider，例如 cpa。

description.en: Model id the supervisor call uses. It never changes the session's own model.
description.zh-CN: 监督调用使用的模型 id；不会改变会话本身使用的模型。

description.en: Thinking level requested for each supervision call.
description.zh-CN: 每次监督调用请求的推理强度。

description.en: A supervision call that takes longer is aborted and retried.
description.zh-CN: 超过这个时间就中止这次监督调用并进入重试。

description.en: Wait after a failed supervision call; each further failure doubles it.
description.zh-CN: 监督调用失败后先等这么久，之后再失败就翻倍。

description.en: The backoff never waits longer than this. Below the first wait, the first wait is used.
description.zh-CN: 退避等待不超过这个值；低于首次等待时按首次等待取值。

description.en: Characters of the branch excerpt sent to the supervisor; newest rows and every user message are kept first.
description.zh-CN: 发给监督器的分支摘录字符预算；先保留最近几条和全部用户消息。

label.zh-CN: 监督回复 token 上限

description.en: Upper bound for one supervision reply.
description.zh-CN: 单次监督回复的最大 token 数。

description.en: Appended after the built-in policy, which is never replaced. Longer text is edited in the JSON file.
description.zh-CN: 追加在内置规则之后，内置规则不会被替换；更长的内容请直接改 JSON 文件。
